title: Content Marketer
description:
**About CultureMonkey**

CultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.

We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...

We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.

We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.

And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.
* This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.
* You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.
* This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.
* This is a role about being remembered.
* You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.

**What You Will Do**

* Write content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.
* Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
* Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.
* Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.
* Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.
* Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.
* Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.
* Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.
* Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.
* Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.

title: Media Planning Intern

The role involves assisting in planning, executing, monitoring and optimising digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

3. Media Planning & Campaign Strategy

* Support the development of campaign timelines, promotional strategies and media schedules.
* Research seasonal campaigns, festivals, events and promotional opportunities.
* Assist in preparing campaign briefs, marketing proposals and media plans.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure campaigns are executed according to plan.

4. Marketing Analytics & Reporting

* Monitor campaign performance through Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and platform analytics.
* Assist in preparing weekly and monthly campaign performance reports.
* Track impressions, reach, clicks, engagement, leads, conversions and advertising expenditure.
* Understand the relationship between advertising spend and campaign outcomes.
* Assist in analysing CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA and ROAS.
* Work with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and understand website traffic and user behaviour.
* Gain exposure to Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, UTM parameters and conversion tracking.
* Maintain campaign trackers, reporting sheets and performance dashboards.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and communicate observations to the team.

5. Lead Generation & Conversion Optimisation

* Understand instant forms, landing pages, websites and WhatsApp-based lead generation.
* Monitor lead volume, cost per lead and lead quality.
* Assist in analysing conversion funnels and customer journeys.
* Coordinate with internal teams to understand lead outcomes and campaign effectiveness.
* Research ways to improve landing pages, forms, calls to action and conversion rates.

* Coordinate with graphic designers, motion graphic specialists, photographers, videographers and content writers.
* Assist in developing creative briefs for advertisements, promotional posts, reels and campaigns.
* Suggest content ideas, advertising hooks, headlines, captions and calls to action.
* Understand creative formats and specifications for different advertising platforms.
* Monitor creative performance and identify which formats and messages generate better results.
* Assist with content approvals, revisions and campaign scheduling.
* Explore AI-assisted tools for content research, copywriting and marketing ideation.

7. Client & Team Coordination

* Assist in understanding client requirements and campaign objectives.
* Coordinate with creative and account management teams for campaign deliverables.
* Collect required information, assets and approvals for digital campaigns.
* Maintain campaign records, schedules and task trackers.
* Assist in preparing client reports and campaign presentations.
* Ensure assigned tasks and campaign activities are completed within deadlines.

Tools & Platforms

The intern will gain exposure to:

* **Advertising:**
  Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and YouTube Ads.
* **Social Media:**
  Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Meta Business Suite.
* **Analytics:**
  Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console and platform insights.
* **Tracking:**
  Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager and UTM parameters.
* **Reporting:**
  MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* **Content & Design:**
  Canva, CapCut and other creative tools.
* **AI Tools:**
  ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI-assisted marketing tools.

Prior experience with these tools is an advantage, but willingness to learn and practical interest are essential.

Educational Qualification & Eligibility

* Students or graduates in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, Mass Communication, Advertising or related disciplines.
* Freshers with an interest in digital marketing and advertising are encouraged to apply.
* Basic understanding of social media platforms and online advertising is preferred.
* Knowledge of Excel, content writing, analytics or digital marketing certifications is an advantage.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Interest in digital advertising, performance marketing and social media.
* Analytical thinking and willingness to work with numbers and campaign data.
* Good written communication and basic copywriting skills.
* Understanding of social media trends and digital platforms.
* Creativity, research and problem-solving abilities.
* Basic knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments.
* Willingness to learn advertising platforms and marketing tools.
* Good communication, coordination and time management skills.

Training & Internship Structure

The internship will provide practical exposure to:

* Meta and Google advertising campaign setup and management.
* Social media strategy, content calendars and account management.
* Audience research, targeting and media planning.
* Campaign monitoring, optimisation and analytics.
* Lead generation and conversion tracking.
* Marketing reports, client presentations and campaign documentation.

Interns will receive hands-on assignments and work under the guidance of the digital marketing team.

**Stipend:**
Provided during the internship, as communicated during the selection process.

**Full-time Opportunity:**
High-performing interns may be considered for full-time employment based on their performance, practical skills, learning progress and organisational requirements. Full-time employment is not guaranteed.

Assessment & Selection Process

All applicants must complete a practical assessment before the interview. The assessment may include:

* Basic digital marketing and advertising knowledge.
* Social media content planning.
* Audience research and campaign strategy.
* Basic advertising budget allocation.
* Understanding of campaign metrics.
* Sample campaign analysis and reporting.

Selection will be based on analytical ability, creativity, communication, learning aptitude and practical understanding.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone curious about how brands grow online and how digital advertising translates into measurable business results. The ideal candidate should be interested in both the creative and analytical sides of marketing.

The candidate must be willing to learn campaign execution, advertising strategy, social media management, analytics, reporting and client coordination.

**This internship is designed to provide comprehensive practical exposure to Performance Marketing and Social Media Management, with the opportunity to develop into a full-time digital marketing professional based on performance.**

JOB DESCRIPTION – PRODUCTION SUPERVISOR
  

**Department:**
Production & Quality Control

**Industry:**
Aluminium Alloy Manufacturing

**Company:**
Sri Jothi Moulding Works

Job Objective

To supervise and coordinate day-to-day aluminium alloy manufacturing operations, ensure production targets and quality standards are achieved, independently operate the spectrometer for chemical composition analysis, and coordinate material dispatch as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Production Supervision**

* Supervise daily aluminium alloy melting and ingot manufacturing operations.
* Monitor furnace operations, charging, melting, alloying, degassing and casting activities.
* Ensure production targets are achieved as per the daily production plan.
* Monitor raw material consumption, metal recovery, rejection and production efficiency.
* Coordinate with furnace operators and production workers to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain heat-wise production records and shift reports.

**2. Spectrometer Operation & Quality Control**

* Independently operate the Optical Emission Spectrometer (OES) for chemical composition analysis.
* Conduct sample testing and verify alloy composition against customer specifications.
* Monitor and control key alloying elements such as Si, Fe, Cu, Mg, Mn, Zn and other required elements.
* Identify chemical deviations and coordinate necessary alloy corrections before casting or approval.
* Maintain heat-wise chemical analysis reports and testing records.
* Ensure spectrometer calibration, standardisation and routine maintenance.
* Ensure only quality-approved materials proceed for dispatch.

**3. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure finished aluminium alloy ingots meet the required chemical and customer specifications.
* Monitor product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Identify quality issues, analyse root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Prevent material mix-ups, contamination and grade deviations.
* Maintain proper traceability of heat numbers, batches and finished goods.

**4. Dispatch & Material Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate finished goods dispatch according to customer schedules.
* Verify alloy grade, quantity, weight and quality approval before dispatch.
* Coordinate with stores, logistics and transport teams for timely deliveries.
* Ensure proper identification, labelling, weighing and documentation of dispatched materials.
* Monitor pending orders and ensure dispatch commitments are met.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain daily production, quality and dispatch reports.
* Record heat-wise input, output, recovery percentage and rejection.
* Maintain spectrometer test reports and chemical composition records.
* Monitor raw material and finished goods inventory in coordination with stores.
* Report production delays, quality issues and operational problems to management.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma / ITI / Bachelor's degree in Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in aluminium alloy manufacturing or foundry operations.
* Practical knowledge of aluminium melting, alloying and casting processes.
* Hands-on experience operating an Optical Emission Spectrometer (OES).
* Knowledge of aluminium alloy grades such as LM25, LM4, ADC6, ALSi10Mg and other foundry alloys.
* Good understanding of chemical composition limits and alloy correction methods.
* Ability to independently manage production teams and daily operations.

Required Skills

* Strong production planning and shop-floor supervision skills.
* Practical metallurgical knowledge and quality control expertise.
* Spectrometer operation and chemical analysis interpretation.
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Good coordination between production, quality, stores and dispatch departments.
* Ability to maintain accurate production and quality documentation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.
2. Percentage of heats meeting customer chemical specifications.
3. Reduction in rejection and reprocessing.
4. Metal recovery and production efficiency.
5. Accuracy of spectrometer testing and quality records.
6. On-time dispatch performance.
7. Proper maintenance of production and quality documentation.

Production Manager / Factory Management

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in:

* Chemical Engineering
* Metallurgical Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering

**Experience:**

* Minimum
  **3–8 years**
  of hands-on experience in aluminium foundry operations.

**Position Overview**

The General Manager – Supply Chain will lead end-to-end supply chain operations across multiple manufacturing facilities, covering direct and indirect procurement, supplier development, outsourcing, stores, warehousing and logistics.

The role is responsible for ensuring timely availability of materials, special processes, tooling and outsourced components at the right quality and competitive cost to support production and customer delivery requirements. This position will drive supplier performance, procurement cost optimization, inventory improvement, operational efficiency and supply-chain reliability in a high-mix manufacturing environment.

**Role Purpose**

Lead the overall supply chain function across multiple manufacturing sites, ensuring reliable material availability, supplier performance and on-time delivery to global customers.

The role will own the supplier base, strategic sourcing, purchasing, outsourcing network, stores and logistics, translating business supply-chain strategy into dependable daily execution and year-on-year improvement in cost, inventory and delivery performance.

Key Responsibilities

**Supply Chain Leadership**

* Lead the supply-chain organization across purchasing, outsourcing, stores, warehousing and logistics with clearly defined roles, KPIs and daily/weekly review mechanisms.
* Translate business supply-chain strategy into annual plans covering cost reduction, supplier development, inventory and service levels.
* Establish a common supply-chain approach across multiple manufacturing sites, leveraging volumes and supplier synergies wherever appropriate while meeting site and customer requirements.
* Act as the supply-chain escalation point for site leadership and customers on material shortages, expedites and supply risks.

**Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Own category strategies for aerospace-grade raw materials such as aluminium, steels, titanium and nickel alloys; bars and forgings; special processes; cutting tools; consumables and indirect spend.
* Identify, qualify and develop domestic and international suppliers in coordination with Supplier Quality.
* Ensure suppliers meet customer-approved sourcing requirements and applicable quality standards.
* Negotiate long-term agreements, pricing, lead-time commitments, consignment/VMI and safety-stock arrangements.
* Manage exposure to metal-price fluctuations and foreign exchange.
* Drive annual purchase-price savings and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) improvements, validated with Finance.
* Leverage group sourcing and shared procurement opportunities wherever beneficial for cost and supply security.

**Outsourcing & Supplier Performance**

* Develop and manage outsourced machining and special-process supplier networks to support capacity and capability requirements while maintaining required quality standards.
* Drive data-based Make-versus-Buy decisions in coordination with Operations, Engineering and Finance.
* Establish supplier scorecards covering delivery, quality, responsiveness and cost.
* Conduct supplier business reviews, improvement plans and supplier development initiatives.
* Identify and mitigate supply-chain risks including single-source dependencies, capacity constraints, supplier financial stability and continuity risks.

**Material Planning, Inventory & Stores**

* Partner with Planning & Scheduling to ensure MRP discipline, material availability against production plans and S&OP inputs on supply constraints.
* Own inventory performance for raw materials, WIP buffers, consumables and finished goods.
* Improve inventory turns and reduce excess/obsolete stock while maintaining customer service levels.
* Manage raw-material and finished-goods stores in compliance with manufacturing traceability requirements, including heat/lot traceability, material certification checks, segregation, FIFO, shelf-life control and cycle-count accuracy.
* Implement 5S, visual controls and efficient warehouse/store layouts in coordination with Operational Excellence.

* Drive disciplined ERP usage across purchase requisitions, approvals, supplier master data, MRP and inventory transactions.

* Ensure procurement governance through delegation of authority, competitive bidding, contract management and ethical sourcing.
* Lead, coach and develop the supply-chain team.
* Build succession capability for senior leadership positions within the function.
* Support new manufacturing facility supply-chain setup through process deployment, supplier development and team capability building.

**Success Measures – First 12–18 Months**

* Material availability against production schedules and supply-chain contribution to customer on-time delivery.
* Supplier on-time delivery performance and supplier quality (PPM/rejection rate).
* Purchase-price and total-cost savings against annual targets.
* Inventory turns / inventory days and reduction in excess and obsolete stock.
* Stores inventory-record accuracy and traceability audit performance.
* Lead-time reduction for critical materials and special processes.
* No significant findings in SEZ, customs, export-control and customer supply-chain audits.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Production / Metallurgy).
* MBA in Operations or Supply Chain Management preferred.
* 15+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement and Materials Management within aerospace, defence, automotive Tier-1 or precision engineering industries.
* Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams across purchasing, stores and logistics.
* Strong category knowledge of aerospace-grade metals, special processes and outsourced CNC machining, including material specifications and certification requirements.
* Proven track record of cost savings, inventory reduction and supplier development in a high-mix, low-to-medium-volume manufacturing environment.

* **Experience:** **5+ years** of hands-on experience in data analytics, audience insights, or commercial strategy within the **advertising, ad tech, media agency, or digital publishing industry**.
* **Technical Stack:** Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Snowflake** for large-scale data querying, paired with practical **Python** skills for data manipulation and workflow automation.
* **Data Storytelling:** Proven ability to synthesize complex, multi-source datasets (1PD, programmatic bidstream/behavioral data, and 3rd-party syndicated research) into concise, visually compelling executive slides.
